assets.prompt: A squat cozy village cottage with a deep golden THATCHED roof that overhangs low eaves, whitewashed cob-and-timber walls, a round-topped plank door, small shuttered windows with flower boxes, a low stone chimney. Painted STANDING ON its 3x3-cell magenta ground pad, a yellow door mark at pad cell [1, 2]. Eaves at ~2.6 m, roof RIDGE at 4.5 m — the facade rises about 9 cells (measure height in half-pad-widths: ridge ~= 9). Door is a 2.0 m opening. No ground painted; the building ends at its foundation line. CRITICAL REGISTRATION: the building FOUNDATION sits FLUSH on the magenta pad with NO gap — the walls' bottom edge meets the pad's top surface, the building is NOT floating above the pad. KEEP the small YELLOW door diamond visible on the pad in front of the door (do not paint over it). This is a SQUAT low cottage — keep it modest and wide, not tall. The thatch roof and ALL of its shadows must be WARM golden-brown and amber — absolutely NO blue, teal, grey or CYAN tones anywhere on the roof (shade the straw with darker warm brown, never a cool colour). The bottom edge of the timber walls must REST DIRECTLY on top of the magenta pad, the wall bases touching the magenta squares — the cottage must NOT hover or float; there is NO empty gap between the walls and the pad. STYLE B, cel-painterly, matched to the game's Vesper character sprite: soft cel shading in 2-3 clear tone steps with gentle blends between the steps; every contour, edge and outline drawn as a DARKENED shade of that area's OWN LOCAL color — never black, never neutral grey; crisp clean HD-2D edges; vivid but warm, richly colorful paint, keep things colorful, with NO palette quantization or posterization banding; hand-painted semi-realistic isometric game art, true 2:1 dimetric projection, soft warm dusk lighting, cohesive autumn-festival palette, no cast shadow on the background, no text, no watermark.
